// See go-humanize-LICENSE. Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-27.
// Source: go-humanize v1.1.0 (40736da3e8ed16369b5e6f109548f243d43a7e34)
// bytes_test.go:63-84, plus Loki's 2qb input and local diagnostic controls.
// Build with Go 1.27.3 and github.com/dustin/go-humanize v1.1.0, then pass
// the original bytes_test.go as the executable's first argument.
// Ordinary Elixir replay requires neither Go nor downloads.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
)

func main() {
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	inputs := []string{}
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || fn.Name.Name != "TestByteErrors" {
			continue
		}
		ast.Inspect(fn, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if !ok {
				return true
			}
			name, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.Ident)
			if !ok || name.Name != "ParseBytes" {
				return true
			}
			input, err := strconv.Unquote(call.Args[0].(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			inputs = append(inputs, input)
			return false
		})
	}
	if len(inputs) != 5 {
		panic("expected the complete five-input upstream error table")
	}
	inputs = append(inputs, "2qb", "+5MB", "-5MB", " 5MB", "1..2B", ".B", ",B", "1,2..3B", "0x10B", "1e3B", "84 \tJB\r\n", "1İB", "1ΩΣ", "1\u200bKB", "1\ufeffKB", "1😀", "１２MB", "١٢B", "1١B", "١2B", "123٤٥6MB", "\U00011de0\U00011de1B", "18446744073709551615.0B", "18446744073709551616BOGUS", "18446744073709551616B", strings.Repeat("9", 400)+"bogus", "1\x00KB", "1\"KB", "1\\KB")
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	for _, input := range inputs {
		_, err := humanize.ParseBytes(input)
		if err == nil {
			panic("expected invalid input")
		}
		if err := enc.Encode([2]string{input, err.Error()}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}
